**Yes. CAPA-26-012 and CAPA-26-015 trace back to the same unit and the same failure mode: the INC-03 incubator door not being fully closed or latched.**

- **CAPA-26-012** (OPEN, corrective): raised from DEV-26-011, an OQ test incident in which the INC-03 door-open alarm activated at 142 s against a criterion of ≤60 s. Recorded root cause: "Door switch misaligned" (equipment component).
- **CAPA-26-015** (CLOSED, corrective; effectiveness check still PENDING): raised from DEV-26-033, a PPQ26-02 protocol deviation in which harvest viability fell below the 80% PPQ-001 criterion. The INC-03 door was found not fully latched on 11-Jun. Recorded root cause: "Operator did not confirm door latch per SOP-MFG-105" (human error).

The two recorded root causes differ (a hardware misalignment versus an operator not checking the latch), but both point to INC-03's door closure. The risk assessment supports this. RA-PFMEA-001 has FM-16 "Door left open or unlatched" for the incubator door, with cause "Human error", and FM-09 for incubator temperature with cause "Incubator failure, door not closed". Both are rated HIGH and affect viability and fold expansion. The shared upstream cause is therefore an incubator door-closure/latching failure on INC-03. Note that CAPA-26-012 is still open, and CAPA-26-015 has no effectiveness result yet.

The other three CAPAs do not share this cause:
- CAPA-26-008 (FRZ-80-02 compressor failure) is a freezer issue.
- CAPA-26-016 (donor CD3% variability) concerns ENG26-01 and ENG26-02 starting material.
- CAPA-26-019 (supplier sampling-port weld defect) concerns the PRDG-01 tubing set.
